title: Cascade Bridge Adapter fixture cases
description: The cases a Bridge's harness executes for an adapter (fixtures/cases.yaml), and how each is judged. The judging rule is declared here rather than assumed by a harness. Paths are relative to the directory the cases file is in.

adapter.description: The adapter id these cases belong to; must equal `id` in adapter.yaml.

prefixes.description: Prefix to namespace IRI, for the CURIEs used in compare.ignore-predicates.

envelope.description: The envelope id from adapter.yaml `source.envelopes` the input arrives in.

committed-case.description: A committed input with a committed expected graph and findings sidecar.

graph.description: The Cascade RDF the input must produce (Turtle).

findings.description: The findings sidecar the input must produce (the conformance repository's gaps.json shape).

graph.description: isomorphic: blank nodes relabelled, IRIs and literals exact. This is what the existing `riot --output=nq | sort` oracle assumes, and what RDF Dataset Canonicalization (RDFC-1.0) decides.

ignore-predicates.description: Predicates removed from both graphs before comparison: the stamp triples a Bridge adds after the mapping.

findings.description: exact: the findings array equals the expected one entry for entry, in the conformance repository's sort order (sourceField, severity, reason).

input-only-case.description: A committed input with no expected output yet. A Bridge must parse and validate it; the graph it produces is recorded, not judged.

dataset-case.description: A remote dataset referenced from fixtures/ro-crate-metadata.json, too large to commit. Its expected output fits in one line: a record count and a digest of the canonical output.

dataset.description: The `identifier` of a Dataset entity in fixtures/ro-crate-metadata.json.

completes.description: The run finishes without the Bridge rejecting the input.

records.description: Number of units (VariationArchive) processed. null until the first run records it.

output-digest.description: sha256 of the canonical N-Quads output, stamp triples removed. null until the first run records it.
